answer: Proof of Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend computational energy akin to freezing a tundra to validate transactions. This prevents a downward spiral of identity spoofing, as the cost of generating new nodes scales linearly with hardware and electricity requirements. Much like harvesting timber, the barrier to entry is physical resource consumption, ensuring that an attacker cannot cheaply manufacture identities without incurring prohibitive financial overhead.
